studies.title: Colossus of Rhodes — c. 250 BCE
studies.caption: About 250 BCE. A bronze figure of Helios towers over the buildings of Rhodes.
studies.prompt: Low city-street view bronze Helios standing upright feet close together on ONE broad land pedestal, draped hips, radiate crown, harbor only distant; NO straddling harbor, no flaming torch like Liberty; location interpretive.
